Have your lips, tongue, or throat become swollen?

results: 1. family history: mother, sister and grandmother affected - autosomal dominant pattern
2. genetic testing (targeted panel or exome): novel heterozygous NONSENSE variant in POU4F1; present in the symptomatic mother, sister and grandmother and absent in a healthy uncle
3. brain MRI: significant cerebellar atrophy with dilatation of the fourth ventricle
4. lumbar puncture / CSF: no oligoclonal bands - against multiple sclerosis
dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: POU4F1-associated autosomal-dominant cerebellar ataxia/neurodevelopmental disorder caused by a heterozygous loss-of-function (nonsense) POU4F1 variant, with cerebellar atrophy.

Alternative 1: Other autosomal-dominant spinocerebellar ataxia caused by an undetected pathogenic variant.

Alternative 2: Fragile X–associated tremor/ataxia syndrome.

Alternative 3: Multiple sclerosis with cerebellar involvement.
dx: POU4F1-associated autosomal-dominant cerebellar ataxia/neurodevelopmental disorder caused by a heterozygous loss-of-function (nonsense) POU4F1 variant, with cerebellar atrophy.
